message.content:
**Signatories of the United States Declaration of Independence**

| Signer | State represented |
|--------|-------------------|
| John Adams | Massachusetts |
| Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| Josiah Bartlett | New Hampshire |
| Carter Braxton | Virginia |
| Charles Carroll of Carrollton | Maryland |
| Samuel Chase | Pennsylvania |
| Abraham Clark | New Jersey |
| William Ellery | Rhode Island |
| Philip Freneau | New York |
| Robert R. Livingston | New York |
| Francis Lewis | New York |
| Richard Henry Lee | Virginia |
| Edward Rutledge | South Carolina |
| Roger Sherman | Connecticut |
| James Smith | Delaware |
| George Clymer | Pennsylvania |
| Matthew Thornton | New Hampshire |
| George Wythe | Virginia |

These were the **56 delegates** who formally affixed their signatures on July 2, 1776 at the Second Continental Congress in Philadelphia.
message.reasoning:
The user asks: Who signed the Declaration of Independence? They want names of signers. We can provide list or mention key figures like John Hancock, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Franklin, George Washington was not signer but present.

We might also ask if they need more details about each signer. But likely just answer with list. No tool needed. Provide concise answer.
